name: rafiki
description: Rafiki: a personal agent on Telegram, running on Cloudflare Workers and D1
author: Brian Gachichio (https://x.com/b_gachichio)

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: The token BotFather gave you for your new bot (it looks like 123456789:AA...).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: An OpenRouter API key made just for Rafiki, with a credit limit set (openrouter.ai/settings/keys).

CLAIM_CODE.description: A setup word you invent (letters and numbers, at least 8). It proves the bot is yours; you type it once on the /setup page.
